title: (feat) O3-6112: Create bill / Add bill items workspace should show which patient is being billed in tablet mode

## Summary
<!-- Please describe what problems your PR addresses. -->
The Billing "Create bill / Add bill items" workspace renders only the form with no patient context and on tablet widths it covered the invoice page's own patient banner, so a cashier could not confirm whose bill they were adding items to. This PR adds the compact patient header to the top of the workspace loading the patient via usePatient(patientUuid) and rendering patient-header-slot with hideActionsOverflow: true, per the Dispensing pattern), so the patient's name and identifier are always visible on every screen size
